questions.stem: A patient undergoing surgery in the prone position is maintained on mechanical ventilation with PEEP. What is the significance of using PEEP in this scenario?

options.label: A
options.text: Prevents alveoli collapse and atelectasis of lung

options.label: C
options.text: Increases venous return and maintains cardiac output
